title: BTC market-phase tags (cycle year, drawdown, Cowen band, 200/400-day and weekly averages): days in each cell

what.name: What it is
what.value_plain: A daily tag table used to split other tests by market phase; it is not a trade test and has no R.
what.label: OURS

what.name: Causality
what.value_plain: The tag of day t uses only daily bars closed on day t-1 or earlier
what.label: OURS

what.name: Cycle year / drawdown bins
what.value_plain: 1 + floor(days since halving / 365) capped at 4; drawdown from the running close-ATH: shallow above -20 %, mid -20 to -50 %, deep below -50 %
what.label: OURS

what.name: Cowen band, averages
what.value_plain: Cowen band side (FORMULAS.md), 200-day and 400-day average side, weekly 10-average above/below and up/down
what.label: SOURCED

how: One row per UTC day. The harness checks that a changed bar t leaves the tag of day t alone but changes day t+1, that a planted edge in one cell is found 72 to 100 % of runs at the stated n, and that a no-edge run flags nothing. The P1 split itself was blocked until P1b supplied a frozen event list.
window: Tag series 2017-08-17 to 2026-09-30 (a descriptive table; the trade studies that use it stay on DEV 2022-01 to 2025-06)

verdict.label: Built and tested (15 tests); descriptive only, never a trigger

why: 3332 daily rows; every cell describes where price sits, not a forecast.
Only 2 to 3 cycles exist, so cycle-year cells are descriptive and never a rule.
Used by P1b, F1 and F3 to split results by phase; none of them found a phase in which the tested trade turns positive.

examples.title: Days per tag cell
examples.caption: Blank (nan) rows are the warm-up before each average exists.
